messages:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout to private-dedicated-us-west-2
- env: private
- cluster: private-dedicated-us-west-2
- tag: v2.13.1
- commit: ab12c3d
- components: runtime, autoscaler, routing
- strategy: canary(2 nodes) -> 25% -> 60% -> 100%
- change window: 2026-03-24 22:00-23:00 UTC
- estimated duration: ~15m
Notifying oncall: @sofia @mike @rachel @kevin

sofia: ack — I'll monitor latency, 5xx, and the embeddings SLI. Post dashboards pls.

mike: oncall here. Emergency playbook open. If global 5xx > 1% or canary embedding p95 > +100ms -> pause and assess rollback.

rachel: adding a lightweight smoke check to the canary job: health endpoint, single-token gen, small embed vector check.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment initiated (2 canary nodes)

monitoring-bot: Observability notice: embeddings p95 increased ~95ms on one canary instance (small sample, starting 22:05 UTC).

sofia: pausing rollout at 25% to investigate embedding latency bump. Hold additional promotion.

kevin: temporarily pinning embeddings route to stable: route pin embeddings -> v2.12.9 for non-canary traffic (will not affect canary).

mike: pulling kernel selection logs from the affected canary node. Snippet:
```
2026-03-24T22:06:11Z kernel-select: selected fp16-opt for layer-4 on gtx-a; observed +120ms tail latency
2026-03-24T22:06:13Z kv-cache: warmed; subsequent requests improved
```

rachel: smoke tests pass for generation; embeddings variance higher but within tolerance for small sample. Recommend observe for 5 more minutes before promoting.

sofia: agree. If we see sustained p95 regression after unpin, we roll back to v2.12.9. For now keep pause and monitor.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused at 25% (manual pause by @sofia). Links: logs https://logs.internal/release/ab12c3d , dashboard https://dash.internal/rollouts/1763943601

monitoring-bot: After pin, embedding p95 on non-canary stabilized. Canary still showing intermittent spikes (~2 samples).

kevin: autoscaler preemptively increased target replica count by +2 in canary group to smooth load.

sofia: see 6m of stable metrics now and smoke tests green. Proceed to 60% if everyone ok.

mike: ok to proceed. I'll maintain oncall watch and raise an alert if 5xx trend or p95 persists.

deploy-bot: Progressing -> 60% rollout

opsbot: Note: route pin for embeddings will be auto-unpinned in 30m unless overridden.

monitoring-bot: Runtime CPU saw a transient +15% during batching on one node group; no elevated errors.

sofia: metrics across services look steady. Recommend finish to 100%. Keep a 30m post-deploy watch window.

mike: agree. No rollback required at this time.

deploy-bot: Rolling out to 100% on private-dedicated-us-west-2

deploy-bot: Deploy finished: SUCCESS
- env: private
- cluster: private-dedicated-us-west-2
- tag: v2.13.1
- commit: ab12c3d
- duration: 18m
- status: completed - no rollback

sofia: good work. Please add brief note to release notes about the temporary embeddings pin and autoscaler bump. Also call out the kernel-selection investigation in case we need follow-up.

rachel: drafting release note: "v2.13.1 deployed to private-dedicated-us-west-2. Canary observed short p95 bump for embeddings; mitigated by routing pin to v2.12.9 for non-canary traffic and autoscaler increase. No customer impact observed. Investigation into kernel selection ongoing."

mike: leaving oncall watch for 1h, then closing unless something pops.

deploy-bot: Final artifacts: logs https://logs.internal/release/ab12c3d , runbook https://runbooks.internal/deploys/dedicated, metrics snapshot https://dash.internal/rollouts/1763943601/snapshot

sofia: thanks team :rocket:
